svg.title: Benchmarks: MNIST epoch and GPT-2 time per token, Bend v1, Bend v2 and PyTorch
svg.text: seconds, lower is better · same machine · hatched bars are off the chart
v1 → v2: 78× and 30× faster. PyTorch is still ~35× and ~2–5× ahead.
